name: Sean Connell
headline: Accenture Oracle Business Group | Managing Director at Accenture
location: Basking Ridge, New Jersey, United States
about:
I am currently a Managing Director within the Accenture Oracle Business Group.

I have spent more than 27 years working in Oracle applications and technology across all industries performing various roles including selling, planning, design, application architecture, development, testing, change management, program management, IT and Business Strategy. My first 20 years with Accenture were primarily in the USA before I officially re-located to Canada to lead the Canada Oracle Market Unit for Accenture and led the acquisition for Cloudworks.

I am now back in the USA based in NJ where I live with my wife and daughters. One of my additional roles is now leading the acquisition of Inspirage, which closed in December 2022.
Outside of work, you will find me spending time with my kids, training for triathlons, and wishing I spent more time on the golf course.
